regime_context: The TSX thematic detector is led by Big Banks with high momentum and durability (0.78) but extreme crowding. A broad majority of themes (12/16) remain eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the sole validated risk-control edge. No rotation handoff is confirmed; margin vs. Base Metals is wide (0.953) and directional flag is false. Macro backdrop is geopolitically charged with high unscheduled surprise share.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the momentum leader and remains eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with the highest durability in the set. Its trend health is robust, supporting a trend-following overweight. However, extreme crowding (z 1.52) is a flag to cap, not fade — this is a sizing caution only.
evidence: durability_bar 0.78, the strongest among eligible themes
hurst_tag mixed, but trending enough to pass eligibility
theses.dissent: The crowding level and geopolitical macro backdrop could trigger a sudden liquidation in financials, especially if unscheduled shocks hit.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate breached) or its durability falls below 0.6 within the horizon.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Although ranked second and eligible, its low durability (0.39) and zero breadth suggest the trend is fragile and likely mean-reverting. The absolute-trend gate may be keeping it in the pool, but the trend-health metrics do not support a committed overweight.
evidence: eligible=true, but durability_bar=0.39 (lowest among eligible leaders)
theses.dissent: Copper supply-demand fundamentals or a policy catalyst could restart momentum, flipping breadth and durability quickly.

falsifier.text: Durability rises above 0.5 and breadth expands above 0.5 for at least 10 days.

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs is eligible and shows a clean trend structure (hurst_tag=trend) with high durability (0.70) and broad constituent participation (breadth 0.846). It is not crowded, which reduces reflexive tail risk. The theme fits the validated risk-control framework well.
theses.dissent: REITs are highly sensitive to interest rates; any hawkish shift from the BoC or a bond sell-off could abruptly reverse the trend.

falsifier.text: REITs loses eligibility (breaches absolute-trend gate) or durability drops below 0.5 within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
